AMBI OLIVE

£99.00

This small carry at the hand clutch is a chic show stopping piece inspired from our first ever AAKS collection. Made from woven raffia with a distinctive round base which gives it sturdiness, a flap closure, a drawstring lining and a colourful leather tassel. The ‘Ambi Olive’ will fit all your small handbag essentials. This versatile style will slot effortlessly into your year-round day-to-evening repertoire making you feel extra special

  • Size: H 14 cm x W 24cm

  • Woven Raffia

  • Linen Lining

  • Leather Detailing

  • Inner pocket

  • Handcrafted in Ghana
